Anand Kumar: The film's shooting was done by the time the controversy surfaced and I knew Vikas Bahl. My father told me mehnat bekar nahi jaati, toh mujhe yakeen tha, aur aisa hua bhi. Unhein clean chit mil gayi.

And we begin the glorification of an alleged abuser. #MeToo

In a post #MeToo era, how does one keep aside the politics of misogyny in art, especially when it's glorified? The makers and the actors have to bear responsibility of putting out such regressive, problematic film.
